label: D1 after repeated unrewarded a1 choices that went to S2 by a rare transition, late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 (100% of mass), only after episode trial 50 (ep_bucket 5), and almost only when the previous choice was a1. 82% of mass comes after an a1 trial that went to S2 by a rare transition and was unrewarded; the rest is on the first D1 of a window, where the previous trial is not in view. It does not fire at GO or D2, after a2 choices, or after a common a1 trial (prev_common == 1 gives 0 activations). It rarely fires after a rewarded trial (3% of mass). Activation builds over consecutive unrewarded a1 trials: in the top windows it climbs from about 0.6 to 1.0 over two or three r0 D1 steps in a row. Requiring the trial before that to be an unrewarded a1 too, plus ep_trial >= 70, takes dev F1 from 0.07 to 0.49. The steps it fires on also sit in a narrow band of the model outputs: value 5.2-7.1 (99% of mass) and choice logit 2.8-8.1 in favour of a1 (99%). That fits a state where the agent still strongly prefers a1 while the expected value falls. It fires in only 789 of 6000 episodes, so precision is limited by some per-episode factor this predicate does not capture. The recorded predicate uses only observed history plus the episode-trial index, no future variables.
